onu 3 gemport 1 traffic-limit downstream default
onu 3 service ser_1 gemport 1 vlan 111
onu 3 service-port 1 gemport 1 uservlan 111 vlan 111 new_cos 0
onu 3 pri equid VSOLV422
onu 3 pri wan_adv add route
onu 3 pri wan_adv index 1 route mode internet mtu 1492
onu 3 pri wan_adv index 1 route ipv4 pppoe proxy disable user usuario-pppoe pwd ****** mode auto nat enable
onu 3 pri wan_adv index 1 vlan tag wan_vlan 111 0
onu 3 pri wan_adv index 1 bind lan1 lan2 ssid1
onu 3 pri wifi_ssid 1 name WIFI-CLIENTE hide disable auth_mode wpa2psk encrypt_type tkipaes shared_key ****** rekey_interval 0
onu 3 pri firewall level low
onu 3 pri acl ping control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable
onu 3 pri acl telnet control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable port 23
onu 3 pri acl http control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable port 80
onu 3 pri acl https control enable lan enable wan enable ipv4_control disable ipv6_control disable port 443
